none: PAS LANCUM-1E02A6: roman coin silvered copper alloy nummus of Valens Reece Period 19
contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ D N VALENS P F AVG

A silvered copper alloy nummus of Valens dating to the period AD 364-7 (Reece Period 19). SECVRITAS REIPVBLICAE reverse type depicting figure advancing left. Cf LRBC I, p.1278. Obverse inscription D N VALENS P F AVG. Diameter 18mm
